historicalRevisionTitle: F2 · RSS · Full Icon Audit Correction
historicalAuthorityDecision: For the eight routes lacking exact legacy Figma surfaces, the user explicitly authorized the local canonical renderer as the visual, structural and interaction-intent source.

historicalDeltas.oldValue: Phone and Tablet RSS content existed only as raw Page 24 master children.
historicalDeltas.newValue: Exact clones became Page/RSS/CanonicalContent variants; no pixels, text, icons, alignment, density or effects changed.

historicalDeltas.oldValue: Refreshing, Empty, Error and Detail existed only as preserved Live Reference frames.
historicalDeltas.newValue: Exact clones became a four-variant Page/RSS/CanonicalState set; original Live Reference frames remain unchanged.
Each master contains one attached canonical content instance; original raw nodes remain preserved and hidden. Four Page 23 downstream instances remain attached.

historicalDeltas.oldValue: Eight local RSS list/category routes had no exact Figma surface and were blocked.
historicalDeltas.newValue: Added Page/RSS/CanonicalListRoute with Route=All/SourceFeed/Novel/Tech/Booklist/Releases/Issues/Discussions and Viewport=Phone/Tablet, using editable local-renderer captures as the source of truth.

historicalDeltas.oldValue: The 16 wrapper components used 0px corners; device children retained capture-dependent heights and Vertical=MIN. rss-all Tablet also contained an extra zero-radius wrapper.
historicalDeltas.newValue: All 16 wrappers and device children use the local 34px device radius on all four corners, exact 390x844 or 760x960 dimensions, clipsContent=true and horizontal/vertical STRETCH. rss-all Tablet now uses the exact editable device frame.

historicalDeltas.oldValue: No downstream Figma instances existed for the eight local-authorized routes.
historicalDeltas.newValue: Added 16 attached instances, one Phone and one Tablet instance per route; no detached frame is used as a deliverable.

historicalDeltas.oldValue: No editable provenance existed for the local-authorized routes.
historicalDeltas.newValue: All 16 editable capture roots are preserved hidden as __LOCAL_CAPTURE_SOURCE__; they are provenance only, never canonical masters or screenshots.

historicalDeltas.oldValue: Fourteen visible Source Actions controls across seven routes and two viewports used Dots/More, which incorrectly implied an overflow menu.
historicalDeltas.newValue: All 14 controls use attached 20x20 Icon/Settings instances from canonical master 271:472. No Dots/More icon remains in Source Actions.

historicalBoundary: No UiEvent, reducer owner, async guard, route flow, motion contract or non-RSS canonical page family was changed. Existing RSS masters, Page 23 downstream instances and reactions were preserved.

currentLiveStaticF0.scope: Static hierarchy reconciliation only. It does not assert a visual design change, reaction/prototype completion, business flow, UiEvent/state ownership, Motion Reference, or VC3/host completion.
